articles.author: Conor Lally
articles.title: Irish-British governments conduct first joint exercise to plan for subsea cable attack
articles.description: ‘Eastern Pearl’ first exercise of its type, with plans for more complex British-Irish co-operation amid Russian aggression
articles.content:
The Irish and British governments have for the first time conducted a joint exercise testing how they would respond together in the event of an attack on the undersea cables in the Irish Sea.
